title: Draw a freehand mark on a review slide
preconditions: Open a writable review slide with annotation tools.

steps.action: Choose Freehand, drag a curved multi-point path over a visible element, enter a comment and save.
steps.expected_result: The freehand path follows the drawn gesture over the slide.
The freehand mark remains visible on that slide.

expected_result: The freehand mark remains visible on that slide.
